NotebookCell.title: NotebookCell
NotebookCell.description:
A single cell in the document. Mutable — owned by the document.

`version` increments on each `SetCode` that actually changes
`code`. Other property changes don't bump it.

CellConfig.title: CellConfig
CellConfig.description:
Internal representation of a cell's configuration.
This is not part of the public API.

CellOutputs.title: CellOutputs
CellOutputs.description:
Per-cell output snapshot delivered alongside the document snapshot.

`output` carries the cell's last main (rich display) output;
`console_outputs` carries the buffered stdout/stderr stream from
its last execution.  Both are keyed by cell id; missing keys mean
"no output captured" (the cell never ran, or produced nothing on
that channel).

CellChannel.title: CellChannel
CellChannel.description: The channel of a cell's output.

MarimoInternalError.title: MarimoInternalError
MarimoInternalError.description:
An internal error that should be hidden from the user.
The error is logged to the console and then a new error is broadcasted
such that the data is hidden.

They can be linked back to the original error by the error_id.

MarimoSQLError.title: MarimoSQLError
MarimoSQLError.description: SQL-specific error with enhanced metadata for debugging.

ModelUpdateMessage.title: ModelUpdateMessage
ModelUpdateMessage.description:
Widget model state update message.

Attributes:
    state: Model state updates.
    buffer_paths: Paths within state dict pointing to binary buffers.

ModelCustomMessage.title: ModelCustomMessage
ModelCustomMessage.description:
Custom widget message.

Attributes:
    content: Arbitrary content for the custom message.

outputSchema.title: LspHealthResponse
outputSchema.description: Aggregated health response for all LSP servers.

LspServerHealth.title: LspServerHealth
LspServerHealth.description:
Health status for a single LSP server.

Status meanings:
- starting: process launched, initializing
- running: healthy and responsive to pings
- stopped: not running (never started or cleanly stopped)
- crashed: exited with non-zero code
- unresponsive: process alive but not responding to pings

MemoryUsage.title: MemoryUsage
MemoryUsage.description: The machine's or the container's memory; unknown without psutil.
